description: QuipMac is a NATIVE macOS SwiftUI app — NOT a web app. All Settings UI lives in QuipMac/Views/SettingsView.swift: a sidebar NavigationSplitView with panes General, Layouts, Projects, Prompts, Connection, Security, Notifications; each pane is a grouped Form (.formStyle(.grouped)). General and Connection already had a craft pass (focal hero where useful, logical section order, the shared StatusDot indicator, ~600pt content column, no dead control-less sections). This PRD finishes that 'organize each pane' pass for the Security and Notifications panes plus a final consistency sweep. HARD CONSTRAINTS (do not violate): (1) Edit ONLY QuipMac/Views/SettingsView.swift for code. (2) Verify each story ONLY by running `xcodebuild build -project QuipMac/QuipMac.xcodeproj -scheme QuipMac -destination 'platform=macOS,name=My Mac' -derivedDataPath build` and confirming the output contains '** BUILD SUCCEEDED **'. SourceKit / IDE 'Cannot find type X in scope' or 'Generic parameter T could not be inferred' errors are SPURIOUS cross-file noise — xcodebuild is the ONLY compile oracle; ignore IDE diagnostics. (3) Do NOT install to /Applications, do NOT run ditto / killall / codesign / open, do NOT touch TCC, do NOT use the dev-browser skill or any browser (this is not a web app). A human installs and visually verifies separately. (4) Preserve ALL existing logic verbatim — importKey + APNs Key-ID auto-sync, sendTestPush, QR/pairing share, diagnostics bundle, PIN save/regenerate. Reorganize layout/sections only; do NOT change behavior. (5) Match existing patterns already in the file: grouped Form, the private StatusDot view (kinds ok/bad/warn/neutral/busy), Section headers + footers, and the connectionHero style for any focal element. (6) Stay on eb-branch; never push; never git add -A — add only the changed file(s) plus prd.json and progress.txt.

userStories.title: Organize the Security pane
userStories.description: As a Quip user, I want the Security pane organized so PIN, pairing, and diagnostics read in a clear, logical order matching the craft of the General and Connection panes.
acceptanceCriteria: SecurityTab sections are ordered logically and grouped: PIN (with Generate New PIN) first; then Pair iPhone (QR block + Send to iPhone); then the two Diagnostics sections (log location + bundle/share) last.
Any status indicator uses the shared StatusDot view — no raw colored-text status strings.
No control-less FYI-only Section; pure-information text lives in Section footers, not standalone sections.
All existing Security logic preserved unchanged: PIN save/regenerate/copy, sharePairingLink, pairingQRBlock/qrImage, bundleAndShare, AnchoredButton anchors, pairingURL per network mode.
userStories.notes: Ordering already PIN→Pair→Diagnostics(log)→Diagnostics(share). Added PIN section header+footer for grouping consistency; converted diagnostics success (green doc.zipper) + error (red text) raw status indicators to StatusDot(.ok/.bad). All logic preserved. BUILD SUCCEEDED.

userStories.title: Organize the Notifications pane
userStories.description: As a Quip user, I want the Notifications (APNs) pane organized with a clear readiness signal at the top and logically ordered sections.
acceptanceCriteria: A clear configured / not-configured signal near the top of NotificationsTab summarizing APNs readiness (has key AND non-empty Key ID, Team ID, Bundle ID) — use the StatusDot vocabulary or a compact hero consistent with connectionHero.
Sections ordered: APNs Auth Key, Registered Devices, Send Test Push.
Pane uses .formStyle(.grouped) consistent with the other panes.
importKey (including the AuthKey_<KEYID>.p8 Key-ID auto-sync + non-canonical-filename warning) and sendTestPush logic preserved verbatim.

userStories.title: Final craft consistency sweep across all Settings panes
userStories.description: As a Quip user, I want every Settings pane to feel consistent — same section rhythm, the same status vocabulary, no dead sections, content in a readable column.
acceptanceCriteria: Section headers, spacing, and the StatusDot indicator are used consistently across all panes (General, Layouts, Projects, Prompts, Connection, Security, Notifications).
No remaining control-less / FYI-only Section in any pane.
Content stays within the ~600pt detail column established in SettingsView (no edge-to-edge sprawl introduced).
No behavior changes to any pane's logic — layout/wording only.
